1: // Simple endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
6: 
7: // Game config
8: const GRAVITY = 0.5;
9: const JUMP_STRENGTH = -10;
10: const SPEED = 2;
11: const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
12: const TOKEN_FREQ = 300;
13: let frame = 0;
14: let score = 0;
15: let speed = SPEED;
16: 
17: // Load sounds (public domain URLs or data URIs)
18: const jumpSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/2102846/jump.wav');
19: const tokenSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/2102846/coin.wav');
20: const gameOverSound = new Audio('https://assets.codepen.io/2102846/gameover.wav');
21: // Preload
22: jumpSound.load();
23: tokenSound.load();
24: gameOverSound.load();
25: 
26: // Player definition
27: const player = {x:50, y:canvas.height-30, w:30, h:30, vy:0, onGround:true};
28: 
29: // Entities
30: const obstacles = [];
31: const tokens = [];
32: 
33: function spawnObstacle(){
34:   const h = 30 + Math.random()*30;
35:   obstacles.push({x:canvas.width, y:canvas.height-h, w:20, h});
36: }
37: function spawnToken(){
38:   const size = 15;
39:   tokens.push({x:canvas.width, y:canvas.height-60, w:size, h:size, collected:false});
40: }
41: 
42: function drawBackground(){
43:   // Sky gradient
44:   const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
45:   sky.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb');
46:   sky.addColorStop(1, '#e0f6ff');
47:   ctx.fillStyle = sky;
48:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
49:   // Ground line
50:   ctx.strokeStyle = '#654321';
51:   ctx.lineWidth = 4;
52:   ctx.beginPath();
53:   ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height - 5);
54:   ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height - 5);
55:   ctx.stroke();
56: }
57: 
58: function drawRoundedRect(x,y,w,h,radius,fillStyle){
59:   ctx.beginPath();
60:   ctx.moveTo(x+radius, y);
61:   ctx.lineTo(x+w-radius, y);
62:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+radius);
63:   ctx.lineTo(x+w, y+h-radius);
64:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y+h, x+w-radius, y+h);
65:   ctx.lineTo(x+radius, y+h);
66:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y+h, x, y+h-radius);
67:   ctx.lineTo(x, y+radius);
68:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x+radius, y);
69:   ctx.closePath();
70:   ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
71:   ctx.fill();
72: }
73: 
74: function update(){
75:   frame++;
76:   // Player physics
77:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
78:   player.y += player.vy;
79:   if(player.y + player.h >= canvas.height){
80:     player.y = canvas.height - player.h;
81:     player.vy = 0;
82:     player.onGround = true;
83:   }
84: 
85:   // Move obstacles and tokens
86:   obstacles.forEach(o=> o.x -= speed);
87:   tokens.forEach(t=> t.x -= speed);
88: 
89:   // Remove off‑screen
90:   while(obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
91:   while(tokens.length && tokens[0].x + tokens[0].w < 0) tokens.shift();
92: 
93:   // Spawn
94:   if(frame % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
95:   if(frame % TOKEN_FREQ === 0) spawnToken();
96: 
97:   // Collision detection
98:   for(const o of obstacles){
99:     if(player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
100:        player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y){
101:       gameOverSound.play();
102:       alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.round(score));
103:       document.location.reload();
104:     }
105:   }
106:   for(const t of tokens){
107:     if(!t.collected && player.x < t.x + t.w && player.x + player.w > t.x &&
108:         player.y < t.y + t.h && player.y + player.h > t.y){
109:       t.collected = true;
110:       tokenSound.play();
111:       speed += 0.3; // speed boost
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   // Score
116:   score += speed * 0.1;
117: }
118: 
119: function draw(){
120:   drawBackground();
121:   // Player (rounded green)
122:   drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 6, '#4caf50');
123:   // Obstacles (red with gradient)
124:   obstacles.forEach(o=> {
125:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, o.y, 0, o.y+o.h);
126:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a80');
127:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#e53935');
128:     drawRoundedRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 3, grad);
129:   });
130:   // Tokens (gold circles with glow)
131:   tokens.forEach(t=> {
132:     if(t.collected) return;
133:     const radius = t.w/2;
134:     const cx = t.x + radius;
135:     const cy = t.y + radius;
136:     const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius*0.2, cx, cy, radius);
137:     glow.addColorStop(0, '#fff176');
138:     glow.addColorStop(1, '#fdd835');
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI*2);
141:     ctx.fillStyle = glow;
142:     ctx.fill();
143:   });
144:   // Score
145:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
146:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
147:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.round(score), 10, 20);
148: }
149: 
150: function loop(){
151:   update();
152:   draw();
153:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154: }
155: 
156: // Input handling
157: window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.code === 'Space' && player.onGround){ jumpSound.play(); player.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH; player.onGround = false; } });
158: canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(player.onGround){ player.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH; player.onGround = false; } });
159: 
160: loop();

(End of file - total 160 lines)
